description: STRATEGY { TYPE BASINS, EXPLORE { FTOL_LADDER, BUDGET_* }, REFINE { ... } } — anytime BASINS pipeline.
status_accepted: STOPPED — nlopt failure (algorithm converged; consider adding ftol_rel / xtol_rel / maxeval to stop cleanly next time)
tolerance_rationale: BASINS is anytime; final basin pool depends on EXPLORE/REFINE budgets and on a stochastic NLOPT inner. Bit-deterministic when SEED 1717 is set on this machine, but other machines (different LAPACK/BLAS) may explore basins in slightly different order. Loose loss tolerances tolerate that; eval-count window of ±50 absorbs adaptive budget rate.
